observation.conclusion: The stored immutable_hash cannot be a complete conventional lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest as written. This does not identify the intended digest or canonicalization.

missing_field: valid reproducible SHA-256 receipt digest and its deterministic derivation
evidence_needed: versioned canonicalization algorithm plus validator and reproduced digest
falsifier: authoritative versioned algorithm demonstrates that this 62-character value is intentionally encoded under a different declared representation
next_probe: define or locate canonicalization authority; reproduce digest; append a superseding receipt only if proven
closure_gate: algorithm versioned + digest reproduced + validator PASS + append-only superseding receipt if correction is required
invariants: absence of evidence != evidence of absence
append-only: do not rewrite the bootstrap receipt
